title: Adaptation Requires Variation
text: For a species to adapt to new conditions, some individuals must already have traits that help them survive. These traits come from genetic differences within the population.

title: The Cheetah Example
text: Cheetahs have very low genetic diversity due to a population bottleneck. This makes them vulnerable - a disease that kills one cheetah could potentially kill all of them because they're genetically so similar.
